accommodation: Grass camping pitches (seasonal), electric hardstandings, Shepherd's Huts and Eco Pods (six of each per Quirky Campers)
suitableFor: Campers, couples, families and dog owners; tents, campervans and tourers
parking: Ample parking (official site); one car per booking on pitches (Pitchup)
dogs: Allowed, one per booking, on leads (Pitchup)
beachAccess: Footpath to Porthtowan beach, about 1.3 km as the crow flies (Pitchup)
confirmedFeatures: Cafe, sauna, shop, laundry, drying room, compost toilets, solar showers, Wi-Fi, playground, event spaces
overview: Mount Pleasant Eco Park is an off-grid-style campsite between Porthtowan and St Agnes with grass pitches, electric hardstandings, Shepherd's Huts and Eco Pods. It has a cafe, wild sauna and shop, and a footpath leads down to Porthtowan beach about a kilometre away.
surfTripFit: Affordable camping with a drying room and a footpath to Porthtowan suits surfers happy with a steep walk.
gaps: Dog policy, beach distance and drying room from Pitchup, not the official site. Grass pitches closed in winter.
